source.note: Offline, reviewed checklist facts; no image copying or automated TCDB retrieval.

decisions.baseStructure: One 660-card base ProductSet; all base cards equally available in the VCS pack.
decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Four cards per VCS pack, 36 packs per box, following the original wax-box format for box count.
decisions.packChannelAbstraction: Specially marked team-checklist packs and late-run Traded distribution are combined into one VCS draft. Their canonical VCS odds require review and are null.
decisions.rookieNaming: RC labels appear only on the 63 unique TCDB rookie-indexed base numbers; shared rookie cards receive one RC label per card.
decisions.variationHandling: Fifteen Washington-name cards and three other base printing variations live outside Base, preserving 660-card base completion. The two team-checklist back variants are separate ProductSets.
decisions.checklistHandling: Five numbered base checklists and the Traded Checklist have clean Checklist subjects. Team checklists use synthetic stable NNO numbers and explicit teams.
decisions.excludedRelatedItems: Topps Vault file copies, Canadian O-Pee-Chee, stamps, wrapper offers, and the catalog factory-set packaging are excluded.
decisions.releaseSafety: Images, pricing, and canonical mixed-pack odds must be reviewed before release.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Complete #1-660 single-series base checklist; equal base-card availability.

productSets.name: Washington Variations
productSets.notes: 15 San Diego Padres-related cards printed with Washington Nat'l Lea. team name. #456 Dave Winfield is not among them.

productSets.name: Base Variations
productSets.notes: #599 larger San Diego type, #608 corrected Apodaca spelling, and #654 position on front. Base retains the other printing of each.

productSets.name: Team Checklists
productSets.notes: 24 unnumbered red-border team checklists. Synthetic NNO-01 through NNO-24 preserve uniqueness; one-asterisk backs.

productSets.name: Team Checklists Two Stars
productSets.notes: Same 24 teams with two asterisks before the copyright line.

productSets.name: Traded
productSets.notes: 43 T-suffixed cards with destination clubs plus one unnumbered Traded Checklist; late-run packs and catalog factory set.
